page.content:
Density-driven global overturning set by temperature and salinity.

How Thermohaline circulation connects

  • Topic: Salinity — Salinity, with temperature, sets the density that drives the conveyor.
  • Location: Gulf Stream — The Gulf Stream is the swift surface limb of Atlantic overturning.

What is Thermohaline circulation?

Thermohaline circulation is the slow conveyor in which cold, salty water sinks and returns at depth, linking the Gulf Stream's surface heat to abyssal flow.

Key threads lead to Salinity and Gulf Stream.
